LanguageData.RSMF.Settings.ShowShopOperatingAlertsTip: Show facility, checkout, stock and service problems on the right during business hours. Hover for reasons and click to locate them. Enabled by default; manual closures, closed hours and occupied seats do not trigger alerts.
LanguageData.RSMF.Alert.Shop.Explanation: These shops need this issue resolved:
LanguageData.RSMF.Alert.Shop.More: {count} more issues. Keep clicking the alert to cycle through them.
LanguageData.RSMF.Alert.Shop.Jump: Left-click for the next issue, right-click for the previous one. Hover to highlight problem locations.
LanguageData.RSMF.Alert.Shop.NoCashier: No cash register is staffed, preventing normal customer arrivals. Check cashier assignments, work schedules and access.
LanguageData.RSMF.Alert.Shop.NoStock: Sale goods are out of stock. Check stock, restocking sources and sale settings.
LanguageData.RSMF.Alert.Shop.NoOfferConfigured: The shop has no offers configured. Configure goods and target stock in a cabinet, or enable a service facility.
LanguageData.RSMF.Alert.Shop.NoMatchingCustomers: The current goods or services do not match any customer type that can be generated. Check goods categories and customer configuration.
